tasks.label: Zephyr: board build
tasks.command: west build -b table_lifter/nrf54l15/cpuapp --sysbuild app -d build/board -p auto -- -DBOARD_ROOT=${workspaceFolder}/app

tasks.label: Zephyr: flash board (J-Link)
tasks.command: west flash -d build/board --domain mcuboot --runner jlink --dev-id host.docker.internal --dev-id-type ip --no-rebuild && west flash -d build/board --domain app --runner jlink --dev-id host.docker.internal --dev-id-type ip --no-rebuild

tasks.label: Zephyr: control tests
tasks.command: ZEPHYR_TOOLCHAIN_VARIANT=host west build -b native_sim/native/64 app/tests/control -d build/control -p always && ./build/control/zephyr/zephyr.exe
